# Widget hinge care

A widget hinge is the pivot that joins the lid of an Example Widget to its base. The Model 3 hinge is rated for 20,000 open-and-close cycles in the [Example Widgets durability report](https://example.com/reports/durability). Example Labs measured that rating on a bench rig in 2025, so the figure describes lab conditions rather than every home. First, keep the pin dry. Next, wipe the pin with a soft cloth once a month. Finally, add one drop of Example Grease when the lid starts to squeak.

## How often should the hinge be cleaned?

Clean the hinge once a month with a dry cloth. Owners who open the lid many times a day can clean the hinge every two weeks, and the [care checklist](https://example.com/care) lists each step in order.

## Where can I buy a replacement pin?

Replacement pins are sold by Example Parts at https://example.com/parts for owners who need one.
